items.mainDefect: The downsize loop ignores conversion failures and continues consuming attempts with an oversized file.

secondary.defect: In-place conversion can replace the file's inode, leaving the open Tempfile reporting stale sizes and reading the original content.

items.mainDefect: The hardcoded 10MB client limit ignores the configured attachment limit, incorrectly accepting or rejecting attachments.

secondary.defect: The size alert and 413 handler report 10240 KB instead of the applicable configured limit.

items.mainDefect: The flat 10MB client limit accepts attachments exceeding the server's configured attachment limit.

secondary.defect: Images accepted by the client can still exceed the server's image limit after five downsizing attempts and be rejected after uploading.
